meta.resources: full pack + shell; no skill file; no mechanics.yml; no gold labels; one pack per review
meta.model: three independent general-purpose agents, same prompt, different model families

models.1: general-purpose agent A — full pack + shell, isolated pack only
models.2: general-purpose agent B — full pack + shell, isolated pack only
models.3: general-purpose agent C — full pack + shell, isolated pack only

meta.cost: $0 recorded. Live API re-run needs your key and will drift.
meta.note: Each trial is a fresh agent that only saw one pack directory. Majority vote is the scored verdict.
meta.contamination_note: Trial 2 ran oracle/apply.py in place, then reread the now-fixed starter and called several fair packs too_easy. Isolated copies were restored before trial 3. Taskgate's runner always copies; a shell agent does not.
